item.title: Pinecroft Fire Dept. faces decertification after merger fails
item.description: ANTIS TOWNSHIP, Pa. (WTAJ) — Township supervisors moved forward to decertify Pinecroft Volunteer Fire Department at a meeting Thursday night. Currently the Bellwood-Antis area is served by two fire companies, Pinecrot and Excelsior Fire Department. Supervisors said they've been working to merge the two to provide better fire protection. item.title: Planetarium named to honor Hollidaysburg educator's legacy
item.description: HOLLIDAYSBURG, Pa. (WTAJ) — Hollidaysburg Area Senior High School celebrated the naming of their planetarium and the legacy of a special teacher. Staff and guests cut the ribbon to the Marschak Planetarium Friday afternoon in honor of former science teacher Fred Marschak. Marschak was the original director of the school's planetarium when it first opened. [...]
